figures.caption: Figure 1: Editing the films with incoherent narratives. The incoherent versions were created by shuffling the takes separated by cuts. Each participant watched one version of each film, one with a coherent narrative and one with an incoherent narrative.

Figure 2: Butterfly plots of the average TRP signals aligned to cuts in the coherent versions of the films, by individual electrodes and anterior/posterior averages. The color of the electrode traces is based on their anteriority.
Figure 3: Anterior and posterior TRPs of the cuts within coherent and incoherent narrative versions of the same film. Cuts are matched one-to-one. Green bars indicate significant clusters.
Figure 4: Temporal PCA analysis of the TRPs.
Figure 5: Snapshot from the EEG cut detection on the film City.
Figure 6: Box plot of the neural model’s performance on the different EEG recordings, by the generalization objective.
Table 4: Cut detection outcomes by EEG recording, manual error assessment.
Figure 7: Anterior and posterior average TRPs of the detected cuts within the coherent and incoherent narrative versions of the same film. Green bars indicate significant clusters.

Table 6: Classification accuracy scores of narrative coherence based on true cuts and DNNdetected cut-like events. The numbers represent accuracy scores achieved by different ML models using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation.
Figure A.8: Anterior and posterior TRPs drawn from false positive and false negative triggers produced by the DNN model in the film-generalization setting. Signals averaged over all films.
Table A.10: Evaluation metrics on City incoherent by model.
Table A.8: Evaluation metrics on City coherent by model.
Table A.9: Evaluation metrics on Art incoherent by model.
Table A.7: Evaluation metrics on Art coherent by model.
Figure A.9: Anterior and posterior TRPs drawn from the true positive triggers by the DNN models trained on channel correlations. Models generalized on the film, signals averaged over all films.
